newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end higher across the board.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end higher across the board.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed higher on Friday, as active buying from local investors emerged throughout the day, traders said.
Prices were 260 to 440 yen higher, with the benchmark March 1998 contract up 260 yen at 16,630 yen per tonne. The day's volume was 88,274 lots.

Price gains in the CBOT corn market overnight triggered buying orders from local investors, traders said. a rally in Tokyo soybean prices fuelled the bullish mood over the corn contract, they said. "Investors tried to cover short positions ahead of the Easter holidays abroad," a trader said.
